```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
```


```{r data}
#| include: false
g <- readRDS(params$graph)

mst_simple <- g |>
	convert(to_minimum_spanning_tree, weights = weight) |>
	morph(to_subgraph, err == 0, subset_by = "edges") |>
	mutate(group = group_components()) |>
	unmorph() |>
	convert(to_contracted, group, simplify = FALSE) |>
	activate(edges) |>
	filter(err != 0)
```

# Summary

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Genomes"
list(icon = "collection", color = "primary", value = igraph::gorder(g))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Groups of identical genomes"
list(icon = "diagram-3", color = "info", value = igraph::gorder(mst_simple))
```

## Row

::: {.card title="About"}
`r igraph::gorder(g)` genomes, aligned against each other with BLASTN on their whole sequences.

- **Distance**: number of errors (mismatches, plus one per extra fragment) per aligned bp, the worst of the two
  directions; the unaligned parts of the genomes are not counted.
- The genomes are named by their id.
:::

# MST

```{r mst}
#| title: "Minimum spanning tree of the BLASTN distances: the genomes aligned without error merged into a single node (hover a node for its genomes; edges labelled by the number of errors: mismatches, plus one per extra fragment)"
nodes <- as_tibble(mst_simple, "nodes") |>
	transmute(
		id = row_number(),
		n = map_int(.orig_data, nrow),
		label = if_else(n == 1, map_chr(.orig_data, \(d) d$name[1]), str_c(n, " genomes")),
		title = map_chr(.orig_data, \(d) str_c(
			str_c(nrow(d), if_else(nrow(d) == 1, " genome", " genomes")),
			split(d$name, ceiling(seq_along(d$name) / 4)) |> map_chr(\(x) str_c(x, collapse = ", ")) |> str_c(collapse = "<br>"),    # 4 names per line
			sep = "<br>"
		)),
		size = 10 + 5 * sqrt(n)    # grows with the number of genomes
	)
edges <- as_tibble(mst_simple, "edges") |>
	transmute(
		from, to,
		label = as.character(err),
		title = str_c(nodes$label[from], " - ", nodes$label[to], ": ", err, " errors (distance ", signif(weight, 2), ")"),
		length = 50 + 300 * err / max(err)
	)
visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, edges, width = "100%") |>
	visNetwork::visNodes(shape = "dot", color = "steelblue") |>
	visNetwork::visEdges(color = "grey", font = list(align = "middle")) |>
	visNetwork::visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE) |>
	visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE)
```
